# Investigators

This mystery is intended to be run with completely new investigators.
The mystery starts with the investigators having shredded their recent memories.
They do not not why they are here and their memories of the last year is incredibly fuzzy.

New investigators start with the following:

1. A value of 10 for each attribute: STRENGTH, DEXTERITY, and CONTROL
2. A HP value of 1
3. A smartphone
4. No background or archetype
5. No name
6. A random item from the below table
